differences.what: Four storeys of pale stone on Washington Street, the front's width and height, round-arched shop fronts either side of the tall arched entrance, round-arched windows over them and the top storey's paired arches, where the stereograph shows them
The slated mansard with its row of arched dormers, the raised centre over the entrance and the flagpole
The sculpture group on the raised centre is drawn as a plain crest of the same place and size
The building's west wall, which the render shows bare: in the stereograph the brick building next door stands against it
The shop signs and the entrance's carving are not modelled; the window dressings are simpler than the photograph's

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
